detail.name: "Moonlit Shore" Outfit Set
detail.desc: Purchase to unlock two outfits for Remielle: Moonlight Whispers and Seashade Pas Seul.
detail.desc2:
This bundle includes Remielle's outfits Moonlight Whispers and Seashade Pas Seul. Proxies who do not own either outfit can purchase this bundle at a discounted price. Bundle discounts cannot be combined with discounts on individual outfits.
※ Obtaining Moonlight Whispers will also unlock Moonlight Whispers (Veil).
